msg: THE WORST POINT ANYWHERE IN THE 48-BUILD GRID at 25.0 MHz: R = 52.5 ohm (unselected catalogue +5%) with the residual at the TOP of its band, 23.3 nH. Measured 31.433 dB = 5.43 dB of margin over crit. 2. The port parasitic barely enters: at this corner the trimmer reaches a true null at every parasitic in 4.7-6.5 pF, so what remains is Reff = R + X^2/R = 52.755 ohm, a pure resistance error. The window is a tripwire as well as a spec check - the PRE-re-route board read 31.19 dB here and the old 7.21 nH / 4.7 pF model reads 31.19, outside this window.

THE WORST POINT ANYWHERE IN BAND, same build, at the 27.5 MHz upper edge: 31.270 dB = 11.27 dB of margin on the 20 dB crit. 3 spec. The band is monotonic in frequency here because X = wL is only 3.06 ohm - the response is dominated by resistance.

MARGIN ASSERTION, not the spec: the worst of 48 builds must keep at least 5 dB over crit. 2. Measured 5.433 dB. A reading under 5 dB means the residual inductance or the resistance corner has moved and the design should be re-examined even though the letter of the spec still passes.
same in band: 11.270 dB over crit. 3.

WRONG-VALUE TRIPWIRE 1 - the nominal as-routed build (R = 50, C_port 5.4 pF pi-split, L = 19.5 nH central) must read 54.549 dB. The PRE-re-route board read 39.12 dB at its own nominal, and reverting L to 7.21 nH in this bench gives 39.12 again - 32 dB outside this window. Any future edit to the residual or the parasitic that is not re-derived from the as-routed CPWG geometry trips this.

WRONG-VALUE TRIPWIRE 2, and the headline of the whole re-route: the nominal build's trimmer setting is 2.3708 pF, computed by ctset() as the exact susceptance null and then clamped - it is NOT at a stop. The pre-re-route board clamped to exactly 1.000 pF here. A reading of 1.000 means the residual inductance has been reverted and the two-sided null is gone.
the same fact stated as the design promise: the nominal setting is strictly above the 1 pF low stop, i.e. C1 has real DOWNWARD authority. 2.3708 pF, 1.3708 pF clear of the stop.
the worst build's setting is also off the stop: 3.7126 pF at R = 52.5 / 23.3 nH / 4.7 pF.

AS-ROUTED ANCHOR: the central residual as reactance at 25.0 MHz, 2*pi*25e6*19.5 nH = 3.0631 ohm. The pre-re-route board was 1.1325 ohm (7.21 nH); this window excludes it. Sanity anchor for every other bench.
AS-ROUTED ANCHOR: central residual 19.5 nH (state.json P7 decision 'residual 7.21 -> 19.5 nH via a 33.125 mm meander').
low end of the residual band, 18.5 nH = 2.9060 ohm.
high end of the residual band, 23.3 nH = 3.6600 ohm.

GEOMETRY AUDIT: the meander's own CPWG contribution is 33.125 mm * 0.4281 nH/mm = 14.181 nH. The balance to the router's 19.5 nH central figure is 5.319 nH over the remaining 9.388 mm of launch/pad copper (0.567 nH/mm) - the one term this bench cannot independently derive, which is why 18.5-23.3 nH is swept rather than asserted.
GEOMETRY AUDIT: the meander's own distributed C is 33.125 * 0.0755 = 2.501 pF.
the pi-split port parasitic, 5.40 pF: the old 4.7 pF estimate plus half of the NET 1.40 pF the re-route added (the other half lands across R1's 50 ohm, a 2.4% perturbation).
the conservative lump-it-all-at-the-port parasitic, 6.10 pF.
the NET distributed C the re-route added: 1.40 pF = 2.501 pF of new meander minus the ~1.10 pF that left with the deleted 7.34 mm lap-pad flare.
CONVENTION CONSISTENCY, asserted as arithmetic: cp_lump - cp_pi - cnet/2 = 0.000 pF exactly. If either parasitic convention is edited without the other, this trips.
DELIVERED PART, high end: 5.4 pF port + the Johanson 5602's 30 pF top stop = 35.40 pF. A 35 pF trimmer (no such part on this BOM) would read 40.40 pF.
DELIVERED PART, low end: 5.4 + 1 = 6.40 pF at full CCW.
band lower edge 22.5 MHz at the worst build: 31.583 dB.
band upper edge 27.5 MHz at the worst build: 31.270 dB - the worse of the two edges, and the worst point in band.
informational: 20 dB also holds over the whole swept 20-30 MHz at the worst build - 31.096 dB at 30 MHz.
informational: nominal build over 20-30 MHz, 51.387 dB.
